rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2005-02-01

rows.author: D029
rows.mother_status: Printed copies distributed to members on 2007-01-22
rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE RATE OF SUBSIDIARY IMPRISONMENT FROM ONE DAY FOR EACH P8.00 TO ONE DAY FOR AN AMOUNT EQUIVALENT TO THE DAILY MINIMUM WAGE OF A LABORER IN THE NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE THIRTY-NINE OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to adjust the subsidiary imprisonment which a convict with no property has to suffer from \"one day for each P8.00\" to \"one day for an amount equivalent to the daily minimum wage of a laborer in the National Capital Region,\" which he can not pay.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05880

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 61, 62 AND 63 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975 PLACING FOR THE PURPOSE THE PROVINCIAL AND SUB-PROVINCIAL JAILS UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF THE BUREAU OF JAIL MANAGEMENT AND PENOLOGY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSE
rows.abstract: The measure proposes to take away from the provincial governments the supervision and control over provincial and sub-provincial jails and place them under the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology.
rows.status: Transmitted to the Committee on Appropriations on 2005-04-20

committee_action.action: Transmitted to the Committee on Appropriations on 2005-04-20

rows.author: D015
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR SECTORAL REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE INDIGENOUS CULTURAL COMMUNITIES/INDIGENOUS PEOPLES IN THE LOCAL LEGISLATIVE COUNCILS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE \"THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991\"
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the election of sectoral representation from indigenous cultural communities/indigenous people at local legislative councils.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2005-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT SEPARATING THE ALANGALANG AGRO-INDUSTRIAL SCHOOL FROM THE ALANGALANG NATIONAL SCHOOL IN BARANGAY BINONGTUAN, MUNICIPALITY OF ALANGALANG, PROVINCE OF LEYTE AND CONVERTING IT INTO AN INDEPENDENT SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE ALANGALANG COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB05873

rows.author: D007
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCLUDING MEDICAL EXPENSES AS ALLOWABLE TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR INDIVIDUAL TAXPAYERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 34 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE TAX REFORM ACT OF 1997
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to include medical fees and medicines as allowable tax deduction from gross income provided that such expenses are supported by official receipts.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2005-02-02

rows.author: E022
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09406) enacted on 2007-03-23
rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING AND STRENGTHENING THE PUBLIC ATTORNEY'S OFFICE (PAO), AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PERTINENT PROVISIONS OF THE ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill grants greater autonomy to the Public Attorney's Office by designating it into an attached agency of the Department of Justice, expanding its organization structure and granting it fiscal autonomy.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05921

rows.author: E040
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENCOURAGE THE DONATION OF FOOD FOR CHARITABLE PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill aims to address the legal liability in the donation of food surplus by exempting donors from any civil or criminal liability arising from their charitable acts.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SOCIAL SERVICES since 2005-02-02

rows.author: C077
rows.mother_status: Business for the day on 2005-05-23
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONCURRENCE OF THE SANGGUNIANG PANLALAWIGAN OR PANLUNGSOD, AS THE CASE MAY BE, FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF TERMINALS, OUTLETS, OR AUTHORIZED AGENTS OF ANY GAME OF CHANCE
rows.abstract: The bill provides that no lotto terminal, jai alai off fronton station, bingo outlet or authorized agent of any game of chance shall be established without the concurrence of the sangguniang panlalawigan or sangguniang panglungsod of the local government unit concerned.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04218

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2005-02-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXCLUDING THE ISLAND OF BANTAYAN WHICH COMPRISES OF THE MUNICIPALITIES OF BANTAYAN, STA. FE AND MADREDIJOS LOCATED AT VISAYAS SEA AND IN THE PROVINCE OF CEBU FROM AMONG THE DECLARED WILDERNESS AREAS
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2005-02-02

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR COMPENSATION TO THE FILIPINO VICTIMS OF WARTIME SEXUAL COERCION, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"FILIPINO COMFORT WOMEN,\" DURING THE JAPANESE OCCUPATION IN THE PHILIPPINES IN THE SECOND WORLD WAR, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Filipino Comfort Women Compensation Act of 2005
rows.abstract: \"Filipino Comfort Women Compensation Act of 2005.\" The bill authorizes the appropriation of P250 million to fund, in advance, the monetary compensation for women.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on FOREIGN AFFAIRS since 2005-02-02

rows.author: E062
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION III (B) (1) OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill includes in the coverage of the presumptive input tax system persons or firms engaged in the processing of home-processed meat products and the manufacture of instant noodles. It proposes to increase the presumptive input tax from 1 1/2% to 3 1/2% of the gross value in money of their purchases of primary agricultural products used as inputs to production.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2005-02-02

rows.author: D062
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING COMPULSORY LIFE INSURANCE COVERAGE TO ACCREDITED BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE \"BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS' BENEFITS AND INCENTIVES ACT OF 1995\"
rows.abstract: The bill grants compulsory life insurance coverage to accredited barangay health workers. The monthly minimum contribution shall be shared by the national government and the local government unit concerned on a 50-50 basis.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2005-02-02

rows.author: A041
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING CITY STATE COLLEGE IN THE CITY OF TALISAY, CEBU PROVINCE AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2005-02-02

rows.author: C005
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING TYHE MECHANISM FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF FAIR AND EQUITABLE ACCESS T0 BASIC EDUCATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVEN THOUSAND EIGHT HUNDRED EIGHTY, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"FAIR AND EQUITABLE ACCESS TO EDUCATION ACT\"  AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill introduces the build-operate-transfer, build-lease-transfer, rehabilitate-transfer and other contractual arrangements that will allow the use of both government and private funds for the construction of school buildings.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2005-02-07

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL GOVERNMENT OFFICES TO ENSURE THE RELEASE OF THE RETIREMENT BENEFITS OF ITS EMPLOYEES WITHIN FIFTEEN DAYS FROM RETIREMENT
rows.abstract: The bill directs the heads of all government instrumentalities to ensure the release of the retirement benefits and gratuities of an employee within 15 days from the date of retirement.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2005-02-07

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE SALARY OF PHYSICIANS AND NURSES IN THE GOVERNMENT, AMENDING FOR THE  PURPOSE \"THE COMPENSATION AND POSITION CLASSIFICATION ACT OF 1989\"
rows.abstract: To enable them to cope with the present standard of living, the bill seeks to upgrade the salaries of government nurses from SGs 10-22 to SGs 12-24 and of government doctors from SGs 21-24 to SGs 23-26.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2005-02-08

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT 7394, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CONSUMER ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES, DEFINING FOR THE PURPOSE THE CRIME OF PSEUDO-INVESTMENTS, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
rows.abstract: The bill defines psuedo-investments such as pyramid sales scheme, ponzi scheme, tele-marketing fraud and technology fraud; and provides stiffer penalties therefore.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2005-02-08

rows.mother_status: Business for the day on 2005-06-01
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PRE-NEED CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: \"Pre-Need Code of the Philippines.\" The bill direct pre-need companies to maintain their trust fund at a level equivalent to the actuarial reserve liability. It provides for a longer grace period of five months, termination values in the event the planholder opts to terminate his policy and the creation of a planholders' protection fund.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04343

rows.author: A027
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT 7916, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE ACT OF 1995\"
rows.abstract: The bill provides that the levy (five percent of gross value) imposed on all business enterprises located within economic zones (ecozones) be allocated as follows: a) 2% to the national government; b) 2% to the city/municipality where the enterprise is located; and c) 1% to the province having territorial jurisdiction over the area where the ecozone is located.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2005-02-09
